name: Hospice
overview: Viktor Sturm is a world—class cardiac surgeon. He is brilliant, charismatic, loved by patients and respected by colleagues. His performance is shrouded in legends: his patients do not die. But everything collapses in one moment — not on the operating table, but in his personal life. His daughter, 14-year-old Victoria, loses her trust in him when she sees how her father refuses to operate on a hopeless patient. For the first time, Sturm turns out to be not a god, but a man. And for the first time, he loses.
